description: The bundled data of Checklist Manifesto Maker: three editable example checklists, the trial prompts and the checklist principles the page applies. The examples are written for this page; they are not approved procedures and give no medical, legal or financial instructions.

reference.title: WHO Surgical Safety Checklist implementation manual
reference.note: Its design targets (5 to 9 items, under a minute per pause point, tested with the people who will use it) are applied here as suggestions, never enforced.

principles: Select the essential actions that are often missed and that matter; leave out what people reliably do.
Define pause points: moments in the process when the user stops and uses a short checklist before going on.
Choose Read–Do (read each item, do it, record it) or Do–Confirm (do the work, then confirm the required items) for each pause point.
Keep each pause point to about 5 to 9 items that take under a minute to check; suggest another pause point when a section is long.
Write each item as one clear action or check; put longer explanations in its details.
Test the checklist on a representative task with its intended users, then revise it.
A checklist supplements a procedure: it does not replace training, judgement or the procedure itself.

exercises.prompt: Find a step that a person often misses.
Convert a vague item into one observable action or check.
Define a pause point before that item matters.
Test the checklist on a representative task.
Record a missed item or unclear condition, then revise the draft.

examples.title: Pack a bag for a day trip
examples.summary: Two pause points, Do–Confirm then Read–Do. A missing-documents check has a recovery route; a cancelled return has no route, so the Run stays stopped and offers the escalation.
examples.scenario: At Before return, report “The return transport is cancelled.”: it has no recovery route, so the Run stays stopped and offers the escalation action and End Run.

checklist.title: Pack a bag for a day trip

details.intendedUsers: A person packing for a trip out and back on the same day
details.applicability: A trip that starts and ends on the same day
details.sources: Written for this page as an example. It is not an approved procedure.

pausePoints.title: Before departure
pausePoints.details: Pack the bag first, then confirm each item with the bag open.

items.text: Pack water for the day.
Pack a charged phone and its charger.
Pack a layer for the forecast weather.
Pack a snack.
Confirm the required travel documents are present.
items.details: Tickets, passes or identity documents that the trip needs.
items.applicability: The trip needs no ticket, pass or identity document.
items.ifFailed: Do not leave yet. Find or replace the documents first.

items.text: Put the documents in a closed inner pocket.
Confirm the time of the last return transport.
items.applicability: You return on foot or in your own vehicle.
items.ifFailed: Do not leave until you know how you will get back.

pausePoints.title: Before return
pausePoints.details: Read each item before you set off back.

items.text: Collect every item you brought.
Confirm the required travel documents are present.
items.applicability: The trip needs no ticket, pass or identity document.
items.ifFailed: Do not set off. Search the bag and the places you visited.

items.text: Check the departure time of the return transport.
Check that the phone has charge for the journey.
Tell your contact that you are on the way back.

stopConditions.text: The required travel documents are missing.
stopConditions.instruction: Do not set off. Find or replace the documents before you continue.
Stay at a safe, staffed place. Do not set off another way until you have a plan.

escalationConditions.text: You cannot arrange a way back.
escalationConditions.action: Call your named contact and agree on a way back.

steps.text: Empty the bag and check every pocket.
Check the last place you used the documents.
If they are still missing, replace them or change the plan.

restartChecks.text: The documents are in the bag.

recoveryRoutes.title: Search for the documents before return

steps.text: Search the bag and your pockets.
If they cannot be found, ask the staff at the station or venue.

restartChecks.text: The documents are in the bag.

examples.title: Publish a static page
examples.summary: The failed-check scenario: a wrong page or destination fails a critical check, which stops normal progress and leads to an authored recovery route with restart checks.
examples.scenario: At Before publication, record Failed for “Confirm the intended page and destination.”. The Run stops, shows the stop instruction and the recovery route “Correct the page or destination”, and the restart clears the failed check and “Run the publish command.”, which depends on it.

details.intendedUsers: A person who publishes pages to a static website
details.equipment: The page files, a local preview and the publishing tool
details.applicability: Publishing one page to an existing static site
details.sources: Written for this page as an example. Adapt it to your own publishing procedure.

items.text: Open the page in the local preview.
Read the title and the first paragraph.
Open every link on the page once.
Confirm the intended page and destination.
items.details: The file is the page you mean to publish, and the destination is the intended site and path.
items.ifFailed: Stop. Do not publish: the page or the destination is wrong.

items.text: Confirm a backup of the live site exists.
items.applicability: The site has no live version yet.
items.ifFailed: Do not publish until a backup exists.

items.text: Run the publish command.
Open the live page in a private window.
Read the title and the first paragraph on the live page.
Confirm the live page shows the new version.
Open every link on the live page once.
Announce the page.

stopConditions.text: The live site shows an error page.
stopConditions.instruction: Stop publishing changes. Restore the previous version from the backup.

escalationConditions.text: The previous version cannot be restored.
escalationConditions.action: Tell the site owner the time of publication and what the error page shows.

steps.text: Do not run the publish command.
Correct the page file or the destination setting.
Open the corrected page in the local preview.

restartChecks.text: The local preview shows the intended page.
The destination setting names the intended site and path.

steps.text: Restore the previous version from the backup.
Open the live page in a private window.

restartChecks.text: The live site shows the previous version.

examples.title: Prepare for an appointment
examples.summary: Read–Do then Do–Confirm, with not-applicable rules and recovery routes recorded as None specified: a failed check keeps the Run stopped and offers the escalation and End Run.
examples.scenario: At Before the appointment, record Failed for “Confirm your name is on the appointment list.”: no recovery route is authored, so the Run stays stopped and offers the escalation action and End Run.

details.intendedUsers: A person attending a booked in-person appointment, such as at a service counter or an office
details.applicability: An in-person appointment booked in advance
details.sources: Written for this page as an example. It gives no medical, legal or financial instructions.

items.text: Confirm the appointment date and location.
items.details: Compare the booking confirmation with today's date and the address you plan to travel to.
items.ifFailed: Do not set off. Check the booking confirmation or contact the office first.

items.text: Pack the booking confirmation.
Confirm the documents the booking asks for are packed.
items.applicability: The booking asks for no documents.
items.ifFailed: Do not set off until the documents are packed.

items.text: Write down the questions you want to ask.
Plan the route and leave time for delays.
Report to the reception desk.
Switch the phone to silent.
Confirm your name is on the appointment list.
items.ifFailed: Do not leave. Ask the desk to check the booking.

items.text: Keep the questions and the documents at hand.
Note the name of the person you see.

stopConditions.text: The office is closed or the appointment is cancelled.
stopConditions.instruction: Stop. Do not wait at the office. Ask for a new appointment.

escalationConditions.text: The desk cannot find the booking.
escalationConditions.action: Show the booking confirmation and ask the booking contact to check it.
